Independently adjudicate the standalone question, fixed key, and two full raw responses (including each response's own evidence) in /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/dune-imperium/2026-11-04-batch-231507/q01-consistency-review-01/cases.json. Use ONLY that packet, the exact rules summary /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/dune-imperium/2026-11-04-batch-231507/q01-consistency-review-01/summary-snapshot.md, and the authoritative original 2020 Dune: Imperium rulebook at /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/source_pdfs/dune-imperium-rules.pdf and its text representation /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/extracted/dune-imperium-rules.txt. Do not read any other file, answer, grade, review, audit, history, parent context or web source. Do not communicate with other agents.
Determine the scope of the actual question under its fixed key and authoritative rules. Review all materially requested construction and disposal parts, equivalent wording and necessary implications versus unresolved omissions, and any volunteered contradiction. Read each raw response together with its own evidence, without borrowing from the other response. Treat support metadata as metadata. Do not demand a particular phrase merely because it appears in a key, and do not infer a procedure that the response and its evidence do not supply. Check the key against the authoritative source. Grade each response correct, partial, or incorrect with precise question-scope and materiality reasoning. Quote exact relevant response/evidence wording when explaining ambiguity. No grade is presumed.
Inspect the rulebook setup text and relevant diagram directly; use bounded text reads and inspect outputs for truncation, recovering any missing ranges. You may use .venv/bin/python with fitz to read or render the allowed PDF; any temporary source render must stay under /tmp and use view_image. Do not change the summary, question, key or raw responses.
Save your JSON report only to /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/dune-imperium/2026-11-04-batch-231507/q01-consistency-review-01/adjudication.json. Include question_scope, key_check, separate response judgments and reasons, material_omissions_or_contradictions if any, precise source references, exact input paths/hashes, and a read log describing complete source ranges/pages and any truncation recovery. No other permanent output may be written.
